answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique cavitation-erosion signature logged on a shared ledger, so a sybil swarm cannot hide its common origin beneath a velvet plume of pseudonyms. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
